no_brows.add: No eyebrows. Eyebrows are a later piece.

no_nose.add: No nose. The nose is a later piece.

no_mouth.add: No mouth and no lips. The mouth is a later piece.

no_ears.add: No ears. Ears are a later piece.

breasts.add: A female chest with breasts. The front of the torso is not a flat board.
breasts.negative: flat chest, missing breasts, flat plane on the torso

head_round.add: The head is a rounded oval, not a square or a box.
head_round.negative: square head, box head, rectangular head

no_plane.add: No flat plane or panel on the front of the torso.
no_plane.negative: flat plane, flat panel, flat board on the chest

smooth.add: Smooth continuous skin, not pixels, voxels, or lumps.

no_hair.add: Bald. No hair and no circlet.

no_cloth.add: No neckband, no cloth, no armor, no pants, and no boots.
no_cloth.negative: neckband, scarf, scarf tail, hanging cloth, armor, pants, boots

feet.add: Two distinct feet, not blocks or slabs.

arms.add: Two arms a little away from the torso.
arms.negative: missing arm, extra arm, fused arm

mannequin-front.about: Front of the clean base body for a customizable player. Eyes may stay. Eyebrows, the nose, the mouth, and the ears are later pieces. A female chest has breasts.
mannequin-front.allow: Eyes may be present. A bald head and bare skin are correct. Do not fail those.
